special_traits.name: Pack Tactics
special_traits.description:
The hound has Advantage on an attack
roll against a creature if at least one of the hound's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hound makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description:
Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3)
Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

actions.name: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone
actions.description: Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
